0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Nets hosting the Hornets in Brooklyn. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee), all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is without Joshua Jefferson (back), also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Nets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 117-86 defeat in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Brooklyn a 40% chance to win.
